description: Quantify hydrophobicity of the two annotated transmembrane helices in ppgn-1 against its orthologues
code:
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0"})
ACC={"ppgn-1_Ce":"G5EDB6","spg-7_Ce":"Q9N3T5","AFG3L2_Hs":"Q9Y4W6","SPG7_Hs":"Q9UQ90","Yta10_Sc":"P39925","Yta12_Sc":"P40341"}
seqs={k:"".join(S.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{a}.fasta",timeout=60).text.strip().split("\n")[1:]) for k,a in ACC.items()}
UP={"ppgn-1_Ce":[(111,133),(225,245)],"spg-7_Ce":[(119,139),(231,251)],"AFG3L2_Hs":[(143,163),(251,271)],
    "SPG7_Hs":[(145,165),(249,269)],"Yta10_Sc":[(116,136),(224,244)],"Yta12_Sc":[(178,194),(294,311)]}
KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,'L':3.8,
    'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
print("Mean Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy of the two UniProt-annotated transmembrane helices")
print(f"{'protein':11s} {'TM1 seq':25s} {'KD1':>6s}  {'TM2 seq':25s} {'KD2':>6s}  {'whole-protein KD':>17s}")
rows=[]
for k,s in seqs.items():
    bg=np.mean([KD.get(c,0) for c in s])
    vals=[]
    for a,b in UP[k]:
        seg=s[a-1:b]; v=np.mean([KD.get(c,0) for c in seg]); vals.append((seg,v))
    print(f"{k:11s} {vals[0][0]:25s} {vals[0][1]:6.2f}  {vals[1][0]:25s} {vals[1][1]:6.2f}  {bg:17.2f}")
    rows.append((k,vals[0][1],vals[1][1],bg))
import pandas as pd
R=pd.DataFrame(rows,columns=["protein","TM1_KD","TM2_KD","background_KD"])
print("\nppgn-1 TM hydrophobicity relative to the group mean:")
print(f"  TM1 {R.loc[0,'TM1_KD']:.2f} vs group mean {R.TM1_KD.mean():.2f} (SD {R.TM1_KD.std():.2f})  z={(R.loc[0,'TM1_KD']-R.TM1_KD.mean())/R.TM1_KD.std():+.2f}")
print(f"  TM2 {R.loc[0,'TM2_KD']:.2f} vs group mean {R.TM2_KD.mean():.2f} (SD {R.TM2_KD.std():.2f})  z={(R.loc[0,'TM2_KD']-R.TM2_KD.mean())/R.TM2_KD.std():+.2f}")

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8,4.2))
x=np.arange(len(R)); w=0.38
ax.bar(x-w/2,R.TM1_KD,w,label="TM1",color="#2166ac")
ax.bar(x+w/2,R.TM2_KD,w,label="TM2",color="#e08214")
ax.plot(x,R.background_KD,"k.--",lw=0.8,ms=7,label="whole-protein mean")
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(R.protein,rotation=20,ha="right")
ax.set_ylabel("mean Kyte-Doolittle hydropathy")
ax.set_title("Both transmembrane helices of ppgn-1 are as hydrophobic as those of the orthologues",fontsize=10,loc="left")
ax.legend(fontsize=8); ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False); ax.axhline(0,color="grey",lw=0.6)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
